title: How AMM Constant Product Invariant (x*y=k) Works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A["Trader sends dx of token X"] --> B["swap() called on pool"]
    B --> C["Optimistic transfer of dy out"]
    C --> D["Recompute balances x2, y2"]
    subgraph Invariant["Constant product check"]
        D --> E["Subtract LP trading fee phi"]
        E --> F{"x2 * y2 >= k ?"}
    end
    F -->|Yes| G["k grows, fees accrue to LPs"]
    F -->|No| H["Revert: invariant broken"]
    G --> I["Reserves updated, swap settled"]

title: Attack Vector
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Fork["V1: Broken fork math (Uranium)"]
        A["Constant 1000 changed to 10000"] --> B["Fee-adjusted k check weakened"]
        B --> C["Attacker swaps 1 wei in"]
        C --> D{"x2 * y2 >= k ?"}
        D -->|"Passes wrongly"| E["Drains ~98% of reserves"]
        E --> F["Pool emptied, $57.2M lost"]
    end
    subgraph Spot["V3: Spot reserve manipulation"]
        G["Flash loan moves reserves"] --> H["y/x spot price skewed"]
        H --> I["Consumer reads pool reserves"]
        I --> J["Mispriced mint or loan extracted"]
    end

title: Defense Pattern
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A["Implement swap invariant"] --> B["Diff line-by-line vs Uniswap v2"]
    B --> C{"Fee constants match reference?"}
    C -->|No| D["Reject: fork math error"]
    C -->|Yes| E["Round k up in protocol favor"]
    subgraph Guard["Per-swap enforcement"]
        E --> F{"k_after >= k_before ?"}
        F -->|No| G["Revert swap"]
        F -->|Yes| H["Reconcile balances, reentrancy guard"]
    end
    H --> I["Validate generalized curve assumptions"]
    I --> J["Price from TWAP, not spot reserves"]
    J --> K["Pool stays solvent"]
